companyFieldUpdates.subsector: Infrastructure ground leases and site aggregation
companyFieldUpdates.description: Accelerate Infrastructure Opportunities, LLC (AIO) owns and manages land and ground leases beneath digital, renewable-energy and transportation/electrification infrastructure in the United States, including telecom, data-center, fiber, billboard, wind, solar, storage and EV-charging or logistics sites. The business was founded in 2016 and launched its dedicated CBRE Investment Management-backed infrastructure-site strategy in December 2022. Accelerate Investment Partners began operating as AIO on March 9, 2026 without a change to the platform, team or strategy. On May 7, 2026, AIO closed a $630 million primary raise that added Mubadala and Australian Retirement Trust capital and brought total equity commitments to approximately $1.26 billion. CBRE IM reported more than 450 sites across 47 states by July 2026. CBRE IM remains the sponsor and Mubadala is a current platform-equity co-investor; their exact percentages and complete legal vehicle mapping are not publicly disclosed. No later platform sale, exit or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 23, 2026.
